title: Tunisian column inscription of the Canaanites who fled Joshua

tellings.quote: there was a column that had a an inscription and the inscription read, "We are the Canaanites who fled before the face of Joshua the son of Nun."

plain: A column in Tunisia is said to have carried an inscription reading "We are the Canaanites who fled before the face of Joshua the son of Nun," Joshua being the biblical leader who led the Israelites into the land of Canaan. A researcher named Tim Alberino tells this on Michels' show, without naming where the inscription is recorded. If true, it would be a written trace of people driven out in the Bible's conquest story ending up in North Africa.
